about: Senior software tester with ten years spent making sure complex systems behave the way users expect them to. I am at my best designing test strategies for messy integrations and coaching developers to think about quality before code is written.
hobbies: Open-water swimming, fermenting vegetables, and collecting old maps.

experiences.description: Own the test strategy for a multi-team platform and mentor testers across squads on risk-based planning. I built the shared automation suite that the whole department now relies on for nightly verification.

Coordinated testing across several parallel feature streams and acted as the bridge between developers and stakeholders on quality questions. I introduced exploratory testing sessions that surfaced defects the scripted runs kept missing.
Set up the first structured test process for a fast-growing product team that had been shipping on gut feeling. I balanced manual exploration with a growing regression suite as the codebase matured.
Validated releases for a regulated product where traceability mattered as much as coverage. I wrote clear, reproducible defect reports that developers actually thanked me for.

Tested web and back-office applications and helped define acceptance criteria with business analysts. This role taught me to read a specification critically and spot the gaps before they reached production.

Began my testing career executing manual test plans and learning how a defect travels from discovery to resolution. I quickly took on writing test cases for new modules as the team trusted me with more.
